name: Sakura Gym Girls
source:
Kitagawa Shouhei is a young man who lives in a quiet town, where he runs his deceased grandfather’s bookshop. His life is an ordinary one, but he’s content with it, even if he hasn’t had a girlfriend in years.

Shouhei is happy enough to while away his days among stacks of old, dusty books, while chatting with his favorite (and only) colleague, the sweet-natured and mild-mannered Asa…

But his luck with women takes a sudden turn for the better when Asa asks him to go to the local gym with her, to help her shed some extra weight.

While at the gym, Shouhei runs into two very different women: the haughty and aloof Tsumiki, and the cheerful, energetic Ranko, with whom Shouhei shares a complicated past.

Join Shouhei as he helps Asa with her fitness regimen, all while trying to win over the icy Tsumiki and processing his feelings for Ranko.

Whether Shouhei will end up with Asa, Tsumiki, or Ranko (or all three of them) is up to you in this visual novel.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2017640/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
北川庄平是一位住在安静小镇的年轻人，他经营着已故祖父的书店。他的生活很平常，但他很满足，即使他已经很多年没有女朋友了。

翔平很高兴能在成堆的、落满灰尘的旧书堆里消磨时光，同时与他最喜欢的（也是唯一的）同事，性格甜美、举止温和的阿佐聊天……

但当阿莎要求他和她一起去当地的健身房，帮助她减掉一些多余的体重时，他与女人的运气突然好转。

在健身房里，翔平遇到了两个截然不同的女人：傲慢而冷漠的月木，以及开朗、精力充沛的兰子，翔平与兰子有着复杂的过去。

与翔平一起帮助阿莎进行健身，同时努力赢得冰冷的月木的支持，并处理他对兰子的感情。

在这部视觉小说中，庄平最终会和阿佐、月木还是兰子（或他们三个）在一起取决于你。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2017640/]Steam[/url]]
